truth_join: Independent evaluation after this frozen ranking; no labels or failures used in selection.

policy.feature: one non-oracle edit affects an issue-named call argument, and that same call is observed
policy.issue_names: exact inline-code identifier chains or call names inside inline/fenced code; no prose keyword scores
policy.resolution: unchanged source-resolved callee with unchanged receiver binding, or unshadowed explicit import
policy.input_reach: direct argument edit or one directly preceding local assignment used by that argument
policy.observation: frontend actual expression after span mapping: same nested call, one assigned return, or same unrebound receiver field
policy.scope: modified owner only; existing frontend symbols; no production reachability or helper expansion
policy.ordering: stable true-first partition of complete existing source-shape ranking
policy.unknown: retain in original relative order; no priority; absence is not independence or invalidity
